title: Profile: remove Additional Information section and add Match History wins/losses by date (last 5 availabilities)

requirements.text: Update the Profile tab UI to remove the entire "Additional Information" card/section (the section above leaderboard rankings), and instead render distinct sections for "Leaderboard Rankings" and "Match History" on the profile page.

quotes: its the section in the profile tab above leaderboard rankings that says additional information, and it should be removed

acceptanceCriteria: On Profile page, the heading/title "Additional Information" and its description are no longer visible.
"Leaderboard Rankings" content (ProfileLeaderboardRanks) is still accessible on the Profile page.
"Match History" is visible as its own section on the Profile page (not a placeholder “coming soon” message).

requirements.text: Implement a Match History list on the Profile tab that shows a single combined chronological list of the caller's last 5 availabilities played, where each list item displays the date and the wins and losses recorded for that date.

quotes: how about the last 5 availabilities played

acceptanceCriteria: Profile > Match History shows at most 5 entries.
Entries are ordered by date with the most recent first.
Each entry shows the formatted date and explicit "Wins" and "Losses" counts for that date (English labels).
If a date has no recorded results yet, the entry still shows the date with Wins = 0 and Losses = 0 (or clearly indicates zero counts).
If the caller has no availabilities, Match History shows an English empty-state message instead of an error.

requirements.text: Add backend query API(s) to support Profile > Match History by returning the caller’s available day IDs and the caller’s per-day win/loss totals (DailyLog) for those days, with user-only authorization enforced consistently with existing stats/availability endpoints.

quotes: show wins and losses from prior dates in this section

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method that returns the caller’s availability day IDs (so the frontend does not rely on admin-only getAllAvailabilities).
Backend exposes a query method that returns per-day (wins, losses) for the caller for a provided set of day IDs OR a query method that directly returns the most recent N day logs for the caller.
Unauthorized callers (non-user) are rejected similarly to existing endpoints (e.g., getCallerStats/hasAvailability).
Returned per-day win/loss data matches the values maintained by recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss (dailyLogs map).

requirements.text: Update React Query hooks and consuming pages to use the new backend query API(s) for fetching the caller’s available days (and per-day win/loss data) without requiring admin permissions, and integrate these hooks into the Profile page Match History UI.

quotes: can we get this information on the match history section in the profile tab

acceptanceCriteria: useGetCallerAvailableDays no longer calls the admin-only getAllAvailabilities flow and instead uses a caller-scoped backend query.
Leaderboard page date selector continues to work for recording wins/losses using caller-scoped available days.
Profile page Match History uses React Query-backed data fetching and renders without console errors when logged in as a normal user.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional canisters/services.
Only create backend/migration.mo if a state/schema migration is required to preserve existing stable data.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths; compose existing components instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not build a full "match analytics" system beyond per-date wins/losses.
Do not add calendar UI or date picker for match history (only last 5 availabilities as requested).
Do not introduce third-party services or external databases.
